text: YEAR 9 TEXTILES · MODULE 8
UNDERSTAND THE IDEA

The three areas are Design, Properties and Performance, and Textiles and Society. They organise the core theory in the posted course material.
Retrieval means explaining from memory before checking. It reveals what is understood and what needs correction.
Project examples make theory easier to apply. A real item connects concepts such as fibre, structure, user and design.

YEAR 9 TEXTILES · MODULE 8
UNDERSTAND THE IDEA

A portfolio records the design and production process. It explains decisions and evidence, not just the finished appearance.
Each evidence section needs a clear heading and context. The reader should understand what the evidence shows.
The final evaluation returns to criteria and project evidence. It shows whether intended performance was achieved.
